body:
## What this listing is

This is Localrent's car hire page for Spain. Localrent lists cars from local rental companies, so the choice depends on who is active in the country. The page shows 126 cars when we searched, with a rating of 4.8 out of 5 from 4,509 reviews, which is Localrent's figure for the whole service.

## What the filters showed

The page's filters gave these counts for Spain:

- No credit card needed: 112 cars
- Low deposit under 550$: 93
- New cars under 5 years: 109
- City delivery: 24
- Free cancellation: 87
- Real photos: 11
- Top cars: 26

The counts change with your dates and pick-up point, so run your own search to see what is available.

## A sample price

The lowest-priced car we saw was a Toyota Aygo, 21.26$ per day or 148.82$ for 7 days (15 October, 7 days), with a 1,225 km mileage limit, free cancellation and instant booking. These prices are for the dates we searched and for one car model, so they are a guide, not a quote.

## What else the page says

The page says deposits are often €200 to 300 or none, and that you pay an advance of 15 to 20% to book with the rest paid at the rental office. Each car card also shows its cover: minimum and basic cover are free of charge on many listings, while full cover is available at an extra daily charge on some and unavailable on others.

## What to check

Look at the mileage limit, because some cars carry a daily cap and others state unlimited mileage. Check the deposit and the cancellation terms on the specific car, since they differ from one local company to another. Localrent shows photos for only some cars, so read the description before you book.

## When it fits

It suits a coastal trip along the Mediterranean where a car lets you reach places buses do not, with a low deposit and no credit card. If you need a pick-up outside the places Localrent lists, compare it with the other providers on this site's car rental page.
